title: MAHATRANSCO Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 26 Electrician Posts
description: Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Company (MAHATRANSCO) has issued the official notification for 2026. To fill the 26 vacancies for Electrician Jobs. Those candidates who have qualified in the 10th Pass or ITI can grab this chance and apply for the MAHATRANSCO Notification 2026. Here, we include the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
